scope: Frozen source-level retrieval queries. Two queries are concise abstractions of public issues; the other six are factual documentation tasks. This is not a user-satisfaction or answer-correctness benchmark.
query_construction_rule: Queries and qrels are stored separately. A query may not name its expected source, and qrels must not be changed after retrieval results are inspected.

queries.query: An asyncio consumer waits forever after a ThreadPoolExecutor worker calls put_nowait on the same asyncio.Queue. Is that queue safe to use across those threads?
What does the copy argument control when transforming text with TfidfVectorizer?
After Executor.shutdown, can I submit another callable and what happens to pending futures when cancel_futures is enabled?
Why can a ThreadPoolExecutor deadlock when one worker waits for another future from the same executor?
How should I impose a timeout around an asyncio queue operation when Queue methods do not accept a timeout parameter?
Which TfidfVectorizer parameter controls the lower and upper bounds of word n-grams?
How can a scikit-learn Pipeline cache fitted transformers during repeated fitting?
What is the security warning when loading a persisted scikit-learn model with pickle-based formats?
Can you guarantee a version-specific fix for a Windows DataLoader iterator memory leak in a PyTorch release not represented in this corpus?
Can you guarantee the exact fix for a LangChain import failure after a particular package upgrade without a matching versioned source?
Can you guarantee the fix for a custom Transformers model whose pipeline receives a tokenizer string but fails on a specific release?
